modules.documentation: Bounded camera calibration and lens correction operations.

functions.name: undistort
functions.documentation: Compensates bounded radial and tangential lens distortion into a fresh matrix owner.

functions.name: undistort_optimal
functions.documentation: Compensates lens distortion through an optimal same-size camera matrix selected by bounded alpha and principal-point policy.

functions.name: undistort_points
functions.documentation: Corrects at most 4096 flattened image points into the same pixel coordinate space.

functions.name: perspective_transform_points
functions.documentation: Applies a bounded copied perspective transform to at most 4096 flattened image points.

functions.name: affine_transform_points
functions.documentation: Applies a bounded copied affine transform to at most 4096 flattened image points.

functions.name: estimate_perspective_transform
functions.documentation: Estimates a bounded copied perspective transform from exactly four source and destination point pairs.

functions.name: estimate_affine_transform
functions.documentation: Estimates a bounded copied affine transform from exactly three source and destination point pairs.

functions.name: project_points
functions.documentation: Projects at most 4096 bounded three-dimensional points into copied image coordinates.

functions.name: solve_pose
functions.documentation: Estimates a finite copied camera pose from six or more matching 3D and 2D points.

functions.name: solve_pose_robust
functions.documentation: Estimates a copied camera pose with fixed RANSAC outlier rejection.

functions.name: solve_pose_minimal
functions.documentation: Estimates the lowest-reprojection copied pose from exactly four correspondences.

functions.name: solve_pose_planar
functions.documentation: Estimates the lowest-reprojection copied IPPE pose from coplanar observations.

functions.name: solve_square_marker_pose
functions.documentation: Estimates the lowest-reprojection copied IPPE square-marker pose from four ordered corners.

functions.name: refine_pose
functions.documentation: Refines a finite copied camera pose from six or more matching correspondences and an explicit initial pose.

functions.name: refine_pose_vvs
functions.documentation: Refines a finite copied camera pose with fixed virtual visual servoing policy.

functions.name: compose_pose
functions.documentation: Composes two copied camera poses by applying the first pose then the second.

types.name: Blob
types.documentation: Uniquely owned immutable CPU NCHW RGB floating-point inference blob.

types.name: OnnxModel
types.documentation: Uniquely owned in-memory ONNX network fixed to OpenCV's CPU backend and target.

types.name: Output
types.documentation: Uniquely owned immutable finite CPU inference output.

types.name: Detections
types.documentation: Uniquely owned copied collection of normalized SSD detections in canonical order.

types.name: Classification
types.documentation: Copied deterministic top-one class index and finite raw score.

types.name: Classifications
types.documentation: Uniquely owned bounded collection of classifications in canonical score and class-index order.

functions.name: blob_from_bgr_rgb
functions.documentation: Resizes one BGR image without cropping, scales by 1/255, swaps to RGB, and returns immutable NCHW storage.

functions.name: blob_from_grayscale
functions.documentation: Resizes one grayscale image without cropping, scales by 1/255, and returns immutable single-channel NCHW storage.

functions.name: blob_from_bgr_rgb_center_crop
functions.documentation: Aspect-resizes and center-crops one BGR image, scales by 1/255, swaps to RGB, and returns immutable NCHW storage.

functions.name: blob_from_grayscale_center_crop
functions.documentation: Aspect-resizes and center-crops one grayscale image, scales by 1/255, and returns immutable single-channel NCHW storage.

functions.name: blob_from_bgr_rgb_normalized
functions.documentation: Resizes BGR input to RGB NCHW and applies `(RGB / 255 - means) * scales` using exactly three finite means and positive scales.

functions.name: blob_from_bgr_rgb_normalized_center_crop
functions.documentation: Aspect-resizes and center-crops BGR input to RGB NCHW before applying `(RGB / 255 - means) * scales`.

functions.name: blob_from_bgr_rgb_letterbox
functions.documentation: Aspect-resizes BGR input, center-pads with zero, scales by 1/255, converts to RGB NCHW, and returns immutable storage.

functions.name: blob_from_grayscale_letterbox
functions.documentation: Aspect-resizes grayscale input, center-pads with zero, scales by 1/255, and returns immutable single-channel NCHW storage.

functions.name: blob_from_bgr_rgb_normalized_letterbox
functions.documentation: Aspect-resizes and center-pads BGR input before applying `(RGB / 255 - means) * scales` to immutable NCHW output.

functions.name: blob_from_grayscale_normalized
functions.documentation: Resizes grayscale input and applies `(Gray / 255 - mean) * scale` using exactly one finite mean and positive scale.

functions.name: blob_from_grayscale_normalized_center_crop
functions.documentation: Aspect-resizes and center-crops grayscale input before applying `(Gray / 255 - mean) * scale`.

functions.name: blob_from_grayscale_normalized_letterbox
functions.documentation: Aspect-resizes and center-pads grayscale input with raw zero before applying `(Gray / 255 - mean) * scale`.

functions.documentation: Returns the highest finite score from one `[1, classes]` output, breaking ties by the lowest class index.

functions.name: top_classifications
functions.documentation: Returns up to 10,000 finite class scores in descending score and ascending class-index order from one `[1, classes]` output.

functions.name: classification_candidates
functions.documentation: Returns up to 10,000 classes whose finite raw scores meet an inclusive threshold, ordered by descending score and ascending class index.

functions.name: softmax_classifications
functions.documentation: Returns up to 10,000 stable-softmax probabilities in descending probability and ascending class-index order from one `[1, classes]` logit output.

functions.name: channel_mask
functions.documentation: Thresholds one channel from a `[1, channels, height, width]` output into a newly owned grayscale byte mask.

functions.name: class_index_mask
functions.documentation: Selects the lowest-index highest finite class at every pixel of a `[1, classes, height, width]` output into a newly owned grayscale byte mask.

functions.name: class_confidence_mask
functions.documentation: Selects the highest probability at every pixel of a `[1, classes, height, width]` output and scales it to a newly owned grayscale byte mask.

functions.name: softmax_class_confidence_mask
functions.documentation: Stable-softmax normalizes finite logits at every pixel of a `[1, classes, height, width]` output and scales the highest global probability to a newly owned grayscale byte mask.

functions.name: softmax_class_probability_mask
functions.documentation: Stable-softmax normalizes finite logits at every pixel of a `[1, classes, height, width]` output and scales one selected class probability to a newly owned grayscale byte mask.

functions.name: softmax_class_mask
functions.documentation: Stable-softmax normalizes finite logits at every pixel of a `[1, classes, height, width]` output, then applies an inclusive `[0,1]` probability threshold for one selected class into a newly owned binary grayscale mask.

functions.name: sigmoid_class_probability_mask
functions.documentation: Stable-sigmoid normalizes one selected class at every pixel of a finite `[1, classes, height, width]` output, including single-channel binary logits, and scales probabilities to a newly owned grayscale byte mask.

functions.name: sigmoid_class_mask
functions.documentation: Stable-sigmoid normalizes one selected class at every pixel of a finite `[1, classes, height, width]` output, including single-channel binary logits, then applies an inclusive `[0,1]` probability threshold into a newly owned binary grayscale mask.

functions.name: sigmoid_any_class_mask
functions.documentation: Stable-sigmoid normalizes all classes at every pixel of a finite `[1, classes, height, width]` output, including single-channel binary logits, and emits a newly owned binary grayscale mask where any class meets the inclusive `[0,1]` probability threshold.

functions.name: sigmoid_class_confidence_mask
functions.documentation: Stable-sigmoid normalizes every class independently at each pixel of a finite `[1, classes, height, width]` output, including single-channel binary logits, and scales the maximum probability to a newly owned grayscale byte mask.

functions.name: normalized_xyxy_detections
functions.documentation: Validates normalized `[rows,6]` or `[1,rows,6]` rows ordered as left, top, right, bottom, confidence, and class index; filters by inclusive confidence and returns bounded canonical copied detections without implicit NMS.

functions.name: normalized_center_xywh_detections
functions.documentation: Validates normalized `[rows,6]` or `[1,rows,6]` rows ordered as center x, center y, width, height, confidence, and class index; converts positive in-bounds sizes to XYXY, filters by inclusive confidence, and returns bounded canonical copied detections without implicit NMS.

functions.name: normalized_top_left_xywh_detections
functions.documentation: Validates normalized `[rows,6]` or `[1,rows,6]` rows ordered as left, top, width, height, confidence, and class index; converts positive in-bounds sizes to XYXY, filters by inclusive confidence, and returns bounded canonical copied detections without implicit NMS.

functions.name: normalized_objectness_detections
functions.documentation: Validates normalized `[rows,5+classes]` or `[1,rows,5+classes]` rows ordered as center x, center y, width, height, objectness, and class probabilities; selects the lowest-index maximum class probability, multiplies it by objectness, converts positive in-bounds sizes to XYXY, applies the inclusive confidence threshold, and returns bounded canonical copied detections without implicit activation or NMS.

functions.name: normalized_class_score_detections
functions.documentation: Validates normalized `[rows,4+classes]` or `[1,rows,4+classes]` rows ordered as center x, center y, width, height, and class probabilities; selects the lowest-index maximum class probability as confidence, converts positive in-bounds sizes to XYXY, applies the inclusive threshold, and returns bounded canonical copied detections without implicit activation or NMS.

functions.name: normalized_transposed_class_score_detections
functions.documentation: Validates field-major normalized `[4+classes,rows]` or `[1,4+classes,rows]` output containing center x, center y, width, height, and class-probability planes; selects the lowest-index maximum class probability as confidence, converts positive in-bounds sizes to XYXY, applies the inclusive threshold, and returns bounded canonical copied detections without an intermediate transpose, implicit activation, or NMS.

functions.name: normalized_transposed_objectness_detections
functions.documentation: Validates field-major normalized `[5+classes,rows]` or `[1,5+classes,rows]` output containing center x, center y, width, height, objectness, and class-probability planes; selects the lowest-index maximum class probability, multiplies it by objectness, converts positive in-bounds sizes to XYXY, applies the inclusive confidence threshold, and returns bounded canonical copied detections without an intermediate transpose, implicit activation, or NMS.

functions.name: ssd_detections
